title: Findings
description: Schema for a list of security findings produced by the scanner engine

file.description: Relative path to the file containing the finding

line.description: 1-based line number where the security issue was found

rule_id.description: Unique identifier of the detection rule

severity.description: Severity level of the security finding

message.description: Human-readable description of the security issue. Must never contain raw secret values.

environment.description: Target environment classified for the finding context

recommendation.description: Actionable guidance to remediate the finding
